title: zalk's stats
description: zalk's stats. read the logs nerd!
body:
**zalk's stats**

_read the logs nerd!_

a lightweight, zero-dependency utility for Fabric 1.21.11 designed to provide clear hardware and performance data directly to the game logs.
Features:

- Hardware Audit: Automatically logs CPU, GPU, and total RAM specifications to the console during the initialization phase.

- Performance Watchdog: Silently monitors frame rates in the background. If performance drops below 20 FPS, it logs a "struggling!" warning to help troubleshoot hardware bottlenecks or shader overloads.

- Zero Bloat: Leverages built-in libraries already present in the Minecraft environment. No additional downloads required.

Use Case:

Perfect for log analysis, debugging performance dips on low-end hardware, or verifying server-side specifications without needing an in-game UI.
